bounds.actualReturnedReadBytesPerSnapshotMaximu: checked size plus at most one EOF byte; partial reads may repeat a requested remaining range, but positions never extend beyond the checked size except the single EOF probe

indexSnapshotSemantics.capture: Original constructor inode/device/birthtime policy, exact physical path, single regular file; final constructor path/fd metadata recheck and finally-close
indexSnapshotSemantics.pathToFd: Original shared first comparator, retaining affected Windows held-parent device bridge; uid/gid and original birthtime policy additionally compared
indexSnapshotSemantics.sameApi: Exact BigInt dev/ino/mode/uid/gid/nlink/size/mtimeNs/ctimeNs and original birthtime policy during each read window
indexSnapshotSemantics.mutableBytes: Size and mutation timestamps are not pinned for the ports lifetime; same-inode genuine appends and coherent same-inode overwrites remain readable as new snapshots
indexSnapshotSemantics.replacedIndex: Same-byte new inode is rejected by original ports; fresh genuine ports may capture their own index and do not acquire tenant authority
indexSnapshotSemantics.boundedRead: Validate path and fd BigInt size before Number conversion/allocation, read checked descriptor length in chunks, probe exactly one EOF byte, re-attest fd/path/directories
indexSnapshotSemantics.nonblocking: O_NONBLOCK/O_NOFOLLOW on index leaf opens only; module-private directory fs adapter adds O_NONBLOCK/O_DIRECTORY when shared identity helper opens directories
indexSnapshotSemantics.cleanupRename: ArtifactStore remove/cleanup rewrites via temporary+rename; original ports continue rejecting its new inode rather than silently adopting it

syntheticModels.inode: Only index lstat and index-handle fstat inode fields injected as (1n<<60n)+1n, then +1n; fd tracking retains original Windows directory/volume checks
syntheticModels.timestamps: mtimeNs/ctimeNs use deterministic base (1n<<60n)+1n on index path/fd, then fd+1n after descriptor read; colliding Number projections are guaranteed by construction
syntheticModels.otherStatFaults: Number fallback, negative/oversized size and uid/gid/mode drift are test-only index stat injections on real files

conditionalSkipReason: One existing index file-symlink case and two new POSIX FIFO cases are non-Windows-only; new FIFO cases additionally execute as exact-child WSL probes, while all Windows skips remain retained
limitations: This bounds only existing trusted index descriptor snapshots and index leaf opens, not the whole ArtifactPorts management API: original store.list/_readEntries and artifact bytes still use whole-file reads
Birthtime follows the existing artifactPhysicalIdentity Number/WSL1 policy; full precision claims apply to required BigInt IDs and mtimeNs/ctimeNs, not all birthtime timestamps
Exact metadata and sequential path/fd/directory checks are not an atomic snapshot or openat confinement, and do not prevent arbitrary swap/restore ABA
The old root/files directory descriptor intentionally leaves index identity/contents false; this patch does not issue a new complete graph or persistent authority capability
A fresh genuine composition may capture its own internally consistent copied local index; no protected root/pin/highwater or cross-process rollback/clone-routing guarantee is established
All retained artifact files, complete catalog/head/segment/witness/retention configuration, independent volume authority and durable inventory are still outside this batch
Existing v2 verify/read locks and authorized recovery remain; neither ports construction nor entire RRSI history check is a physical open-only reader
No independent installation approval, producer receipts, candidate alias, Registry release source gate, real model/cost experiment or production promotion is enabled
WSL probes use the already SHA-verified local Linux Node 22.22.2 toolchain without npm or downloads; this is not full Linux Vitest, macOS or a release matrix
